head.title: Čarokavárna – a magical café in Brno where magic comes alive
head.description: Čarokavárna — a magical café in Brno city centre. Specialty coffee, smoking potions, magical cakes and a cauldron of dry-ice mist.

text.hero.line2: a place where magic comes alive and dreams come true.
text.about.title:
We're a small escape
from the hectic world.
text.about.p1: A place that awakens our inner child. Come take a break from the everyday rush and step into the world of spells and magic.
text.about.p2: Here you can leave your worries at the door and rediscover the honest joy and imagination of childhood.
text.about.p3: At Čarokavárna we believe you're never too old for magic. So we created a place where, at least for a moment, you can return to your childhood, let our enchanting atmosphere carry you away and enjoy moments you'll remember with a smile.
text.decor.p1: At Čarokavárna we take pride in originality and uniqueness. Our decorations aren't just ordinary interior accessories. They are one-of-a-kind custom-made pieces, with attention to every detail. Many of them are even life-sized, so you can enjoy the magical world quite literally within arm's reach.
text.decor.p2: We keep improving Čarokavárna and taking it further. Since it opened, the interior has gone through a big transformation and has gradually filled up with all kinds of decorations, each with its own soul and story.
text.leaflet.p1: Here at Čarokavárna we can turn ordinary things into something extraordinary.
text.leaflet.p2: That's why you won't get just any old menu. Ours is magical, and it carefully guards its contents from the eyes of all muggles.
text.leaflet.p3: A true wizard has to conjure up their own menu! Just take our special magic wand in your hand and reveal the secrets hidden on its pages.
text.leaflet.p4: And believe us — truly anyone can master this spell! ✨
text.faq.a1: Of course! ❤️ Čarokavárna is open to little and grown-up wizards alike, and there's no age limit. You're welcome to come with a pram, too.
text.faq.q2: Can I buy a gift voucher?
text.faq.a2:
Yes! At Čarokavárna we offer gift vouchers worth 500 CZK and 1,000 CZK, depending on current availability.

Vouchers can only be bought in person, right at Čarokavárna. Unfortunately, we don't sell or send vouchers online.
text.faq.a3: Unfortunately not. Dogs aren't allowed anywhere in the arcade where Čarokavárna is located. Thank you for understanding.
text.faq.q4: Are the wizard cloaks and other props free to borrow?
text.faq.a4: Yes! All the props we lend out are completely free. Whether it's wizard cloaks, hats, masks, wands or board games, you can try everything during your visit at no charge.
text.faq.a5: No, there's no entrance fee. You only pay for what you order.
text.faq.a6:
On weekends, public holidays and during school holidays we strongly recommend booking, as we're often full.

On weekdays outside holidays you usually don't need a reservation, but if you want to be sure of a table, we recommend booking one.
text.faq.q7: Can we come without a reservation?
text.faq.a7:
Of course! We keep four tables reserved for guests without a booking.

On weekends, public holidays and during school holidays they may all be taken, though. In that case, just wait a little while until one frees up.

On weekdays outside holidays you'll usually get in without a reservation and without waiting.
text.faq.q8: How long can I book a table for?
text.faq.a8: A standard reservation lasts one hour. If you'd like to enjoy the magical atmosphere longer, you can also book the next time slot.
text.faq.q9: Do you have gluten-free and lactose-free desserts?
text.faq.a9:
Yes, we do! Fresh gluten-free and lactose-free desserts are delivered every Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday.

Sometimes a few are left for the following day, but on those days you can be most sure to find them.
text.faq.q10: Do you decorate tables for birthdays?
text.faq.a10:
Unfortunately, we can't provide birthday table decorations due to capacity reasons.

But we're happy to make your birthday a little more special! We can put a birthday candle in a dessert of your choice and light it for you.
text.winter.p1: We've prepared a special selection of winter drinks to warm you up, cheer you up and make the cold days more pleasant.
text.winter.p2: We'll give you a little taste in the photos — but what our winter specials really hide? That you'll have to come and discover yourself!
text.unique.p1: At Čarokavárna we take pride in originality, unique details and above all in experiences you won't find just anywhere. So what makes us special?
text.unique.f1.title: A wizard's menu
text.unique.f1.text: Forget ordinary drinks menus! Here you have to conjure up your menu yourself.
text.unique.f2.title: Unique decorations
text.unique.f2.text: Original custom-made decorations, many of them life-sized. Each one has its own soul and story.
text.unique.f3.title: A sugar cloud that sweetens your coffee
text.unique.f3.text: Our Čarokavárna special! Café lungo with a little sugar cloud that melts in the rising steam and rains sweetly right into your cup.
text.unique.f4.title: Wizard props and masks
text.unique.f4.text: Here you can become a part of the magical world! Borrow cloaks, hats, wands or original masks and have a bit of fun.
text.unique.f5.title: Something new every time
text.unique.f5.text: We keep improving Čarokavárna, adding new decorations and coming up with more ideas. So every visit you can discover something new.
text.special.title2: a sugar cloud that sweetens your coffee ☁️
text.special.p1: Café lungo with a fluffy cotton-candy cloud that slowly melts in the steam rising from the hot coffee and starts to rain sweetly into your cup.
text.paintings.title: Magic paintings 🪄
text.paintings.p1: Hardly anyone notices at first glance. But did you know the paintings behind our bar aren't entirely ordinary?
text.paintings.p2: Look closely, and you'll find that they move.
text.chest.title: The magic chest 🗝️
text.chest.p1: Dare to solve our enchanted riddle? If you manage it, the treasure from the magic chest could be yours!
text.chest.p2: And don't worry, our treasures aren't just for little wizards. Kids and grown-ups alike will find something for themselves.
text.special.p2: A coffee experience you'll only find here!
text.rental.p1: To make your Čarokavárna experience even more intense, you can borrow our wizard cloaks, hats, wands or themed glasses.
text.rental.p2: And if you're up for a bit of fun, you can play board games or fool around in our original masks, which you can borrow in our photo corner by the platform.
text.potions.p1: We serve our potions in original themed glasses with a smoking effect. Every potion has its own unique glass that completes the whole magical experience.
text.potions.p2: You'll find both alcoholic and non-alcoholic potions that will enchant you from the very first sip.
text.lemonade.p1: We make our homemade lemonades ourselves from fresh fruit.
text.potions.p3: We change our selection regularly, so after the New Year you can look forward to new and exciting additions.
text.cakes.title2: that delight more than just your eyes…
text.cakes.p1: At Čarokavárna we take pride in a varied selection of original, themed treats that will enchant you not only with their looks but with their taste too.
text.cakes.p2: We change our selection regularly, so every visit you can discover and taste something new.
text.cakes.p3: And our selection also includes gluten-free and lactose-free desserts. 🌿
text.cakes.p4: Here is a small sample of our magical treats. ✨
text.leaflet.hint: Follow the magic wand, which reveals what the naked eye cannot see.
text.leaflet.hintWand: Follow the magic wand — it reveals what the menu hides.
